description: List the tours Follow On Tours currently has published. Use this to find out what is on sale before asking about a specific tour. Returns only published tours — the same set a visitor can see on the website — in `tours`, each with its page `url`, dates, `nights`, `fixtures` (the matches), `hotels`, `included`, `notIncluded` and `optionalExtras`. When `priceBasis` is "per person", `fromPricePerPerson` (two sharing) and `singleOccupancyFromPrice` are the lowest selling prices shown on the tour page, in `currency`: quote them as "from" prices, exactly as given, never as a final price for a particular group, and say what one price covers from `pricedPer` (on a multi-match tour it is one match, not the whole series). When `priceBasis` is "not yet priced", say the price is on request and never estimate one. Every trip in every list carries `status` (bookable, on_request, register_interest or sold_out) and `availability` (available, limited, sold_out or on_request); limited means some ticket categories or hotels have already sold out. Never state or guess how many rooms, seats or tickets are left. The `paymentTerms` on each tour give the deposit (or "Confirmed on the quote" when none is set), when the balance is due and the date, quoted exactly; never add terms that are not there. Tours Follow On Tours is quoting now but builds to order (no published programme, no online checkout) come back in `bespokeTours`: they ARE available, quoted on enquiry. Trips available now but sold on request (no fixed dates, no published price, quoted for each group; e.g. golf in Argentina) come back in `onRequestTrips`, with the full public page text in `details`: offer them, and use request_quote to ask for a quote. Tours that are announced but NOT yet on sale come back separately in `holdingTours`: they cannot be booked and their schedules are not confirmed, so never present one as bookable. A coming-soon tour may carry `details` — the full public text of its page (intro, sections, FAQs) — which is safe to quote. For the golf trips use list_golf_trips.
name: list_tours
